questions.question: Please verify the attribution of the 1912 result about a trigonometric series whose coefficients tend to zero while the series diverges almost everywhere. The comment credits Luzin; it should be compared with Menshov’s work and the precise statements of the relevant theorems. The source paragraph is retained in both languages pending review.

questions.resolution: Luzin himself confirms the attribution and statement in section 61 of The Integral and the Trigonometric Series (https://djvu.online/file/4QUaip4NzH6ES). He cites the German publication of 1911; Matematicheskii Sbornik records the Russian version of 1912 (https://www.mathnet.ru/eng/sm6532). Menshov’s null series is a separate result.
